## What's new

**No keychain questions at the first start.** On a Mac whose user has no login keychain, 1.5.0 and 1.5.1 showed macOS's "Keychain Not Found" dialog twice when the app started, before anything was saved. Since 1.5.0 the token of the app's MCP endpoint is stored encrypted, and the app made one on its very first start, so it asked the keychain for a key right away.

- A new installation starts without touching the keychain. The MCP endpoint's token is made when you turn the endpoint on.
- On a Mac without a login keychain the app never triggers those dialogs. A password or API key you save is then stored without real encryption, and the connection form and the AI settings say so and how to fix it (Keychain Access → File → New Keychain, named "login"); once the keychain exists, the next save encrypts.
- Nothing changes for saved passwords on a Mac with a keychain, or on Windows and Linux.

If you saw the dialogs: choosing *Reset To Defaults* in them creates the login keychain, and they don't come back.

Everything new in 1.5 is in the [1.5.0 notes](https://github.com/eLh0m3r0/db-mastermind/releases/tag/v1.5.0); 1.5.1 made AI on a model work without a database.

Updates itself on Windows (installer), macOS and Linux (AppImage). The [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9p0grd7bz4nf) version updates through the Store.

## Download

| | |
|---|---|
| Windows, signed by Microsoft | [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9p0grd7bz4nf) |
| Windows, no installation | `DB-Mastermind-1.5.2-win-x64-portable.zip`: unzip and run `DB Mastermind.exe` |
| Windows installer (no admin, updates itself) | `DB-Mastermind-1.5.2-win-x64-setup.exe` |
| Windows for IT (per machine) | `DB-Mastermind-1.5.2-win-x64.msi` |
| Windows via Scoop | `scoop install https://github.com/eLh0m3r0/db-mastermind/releases/latest/download/db-mastermind.json` |
| macOS | `…-mac-arm64.dmg` (Apple Silicon) / `…-mac-x64.dmg` (Intel), or `brew tap elh0m3r0/db-mastermind https://github.com/eLh0m3r0/db-mastermind && brew install --cask db-mastermind`. First launch: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway (the app is not notarized yet) |
| Linux | `DB-Mastermind-linux-x86_64.AppImage` (updates itself; needs FUSE 2, `libfuse2t64` on Ubuntu 24.04) or `.deb` |
| MCP server and command line | `npx -y dbmastermind-mcp` · `npx -p dbmastermind-mcp dbm` |
